name: Stalkerhide Cloak
description: A hooded cloak tanned from a single Thornroot Stalker hide using elven processes that preserve the stalker's field-illegibility trace. Functions as supplementary light armor layered over existing light or medium armor; does not stack with heavier armor torso protection.
narrative_effects: Provides light-armor protection consistent with a worn-over-clothing field cloak; layers on existing light or medium armor without agility penalty.

The hide's field-illegibility trace softens ambient magical awareness of the wearer when the hood is up and the wearer is still — attuned sentries and bound wards register the wearer less reliably. Does not confer invisibility to ordinary sight, scent, or hearing.
Stalkerhide is not traded. A cloak of this kind comes from a hunt the wearer was present for, or from a house that owes the wearer a specific debt.

Inside the Feywood it marks the wearer as someone who has either taken a stalker, inherited from one who did, or been gifted by a house that has. Outside the Feywood it draws attention from any elf who recognizes the material.

mechanical_effect.modifier: +10 target vs magical detection; +5 target vs mundane sight, scent, or hearing
mechanical_effect.applies_to: stealth, evasion, and concealment checks where the failure risk is being detected by another creature, ward, or place. The +10 modifier applies when the detector is a magical field, ward, entity, or ambient awareness. The +5 modifier applies when the detector is mundane sight, scent, or hearing.
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: physical hazards that affect a volume regardless of presence (fire, flood, falling debris); active combat once detection is no longer the question
